Saturday pizza night on the truck started May 2024. Three doughs tested over the summer, these are the numbers that stuck.

## Baker's percentages, quick refresher

Everything as a % of flour weight. Flour is always 100. 1000 g flour at 65% hydration = 650 g water. Salt 2.8%, instant yeast 0.2% for a long cold ferment. Write it like this and scaling is easy, Tash.

## Flour

- Caputo Pizzeria (blue bag), W 260-270, 25 kg sack £38 from Carlo at Pasta Factory on Shudehill
- Caputo Nuvola for the 70% dough, more open
- tried Tesco strong white at 65%: tore when stretching, gave up after one batch

## 62%: the Ooni dough

For the Ooni Koda 16 at home and at events where we bring it. 450 to 480°C stone, 60 to 90 seconds bake. Lower water because at that heat a wet dough burns before it cooks through. Easy to stretch, slight chew.

- 1000 g Caputo Pizzeria
- 620 g water at 18°C
- 28 g salt
- 2 g instant yeast

## 65%: the truck dough

The truck oven only gets to 300°C on the steel, bake is 4 to 5 minutes. A bit more water so it doesn't dry out in the longer bake. This is the house dough, 40 balls a Saturday.

- 5 kg Caputo Pizzeria, 3.25 kg water, 140 g salt, 10 g yeast
- plus 10% levain (500 g) from [[Sourdough starter]], for flavour, not rise

## 70%: home tray pizza

Roman-style al taglio in a 40 x 30 cm blue steel tray, Nuvola flour, 230°C home oven. Too slack for hand-stretching rounds, perfect in a tray. 3 sets of coil stretches, 30 min apart.

## Cold retard

- bulk 2 h at room temp (20 to 22°C)
- ball, then into the walk-in at 3°C
- 48 h is good, 72 h is better, 96 h starts tasting boozy and the balls go flat
- out 3 hours before service, they need to be at 18°C plus to stretch

## Balling

260 g balls for 12 inch, 280 g for the truck's 13 inch. Tight skin, pinched shut underneath. Dough box with a lid, 6 balls per box, light oil.

## Oven

Truck oven setting vs reality was off by up to 17 degrees ([[Oven thermometer calibration]]). For pizza I go by the IR gun on the steel: 300°C or nothing. Preheat 45 min.

## Mistakes

- June 2024: 70% dough in the truck oven, slid off the peel in a heap. Back to 65.
- forgot salt once (8 June). Tasted of nothing, binned 40 balls, £31 of flour
- yeast at 1% for a 72 h retard: blew up, sour, overproofed. 0.2% is right
- bagels are a stiffer cousin of this, 57%, see [[Bagel boiling]]

## Costs per pizza

Dough £0.42, sauce (San Marzano, salt, basil) £0.35, fior di latte £0.95. Margherita sells at £9.
